## Closed `not_planned` — a test-harness blind spot with no fleet decision it would change

Path: fleet decision — none nameable | 缺项 | none

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T07:38Z. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main` `d999617`.

The reading is right: `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS`'s two-way check compares the set of overridden targets with the set of reason keys, so a stale reason whose target still names its custom selector passes, and the docblock promises it fails.

It is `tooling` (a test harness), and a tooling card is graded by what the fleet would do differently once it lands. A stale override reason keeps a target on its custom readiness selector: the sweep still runs that target and still catches a leak, so no dispatch, landing or review changes. With nothing to name, the North Star's instrument rule says it is not done. Where a gate claims more than it checks, the cheaper correction is fewer parts: narrow the docblock to what the assertion does.

**The repair, for whoever next edits `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`**: narrow the docblock to "an override without a reason fails", or add the render-with-the-default check if that PR needs it.

**Reopen when** a stale override is shown to mask a real leak — name the target and the leak.
